{{Quote|I wouldn't risk it. Balmorra's the birthplace of the Mark-37 combat droid. Building newer, deadlier models is a charming local tradition.|Darmas Pollaran|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Mark-37 combat droid''' was a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was designed and built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] prior to the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
